assessment.why: A circumstantial accusation is now defensible: Justin admits handling the recovered poison original and target glass, while kit bottle, prop, sealed favor and scholarly requests have specific alternative explanations. It is not a uniquely proved causal chain: contaminated miniature and fragment lack named custody and theft is unassigned.

plausibility_notes: The accused can innocently move a wrongly identified bottle after someone else doses the glass. No text evidence identifies who possessed the contaminated miniature or fractured the original neck. A defensible leading accusation remains weaker than exclusion of all rivals.
